# query-rewriter

> Rewrite and expand retrieval queries with multi-query, HyDE and step-back prompts through the canonical LLM port, plus a no-model synonym expansion. Python package `trysac-query-rewriter`, import name `query_rewriter`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
